title: Polynomial-Time Liar-Round Test
statement: For every bit string $z$, the function sending $z$ to the singleton list containing the Boolean result of the liar-round test on $z$ is computable by a deterministic finite-state Turing machine in time $C(n+1)^c$ on every input of length $n$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not fully specify the arithmetic routines used by the liar-round test.
